title: Squared norm of a centered affine function
statement: Let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a probability space, and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ belong to $L^2(\mu)$ with mean zero. For all $a,b\in\mathbb R$, the real-valued random-variable norm satisfies $N_2(a+bX)^2=a^2+b^2N_2(X)^2$.
replaced: Let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a probability space, let $X\in L^2(\mu)$ satisfy $\E X=0$, and let $a,b\in\bbr$. Then $\|a+bX\|_2^2=a^2+b^2\|X\|_2^2$.
